Backend field_modifications stamping, notifications module extraction, and SSE stream all verified working. ui_bugs.issue: Audit trail line NOT rendered after Save for the part_pension_actual_independence_pct input-style prompt. Element [data-testid='profile-prompt-part_pension_actual_independence_pct-trail'] never appears in DOM after clicking 'Save to profile'. integration_issues.issue: After saving the inline prompt value 17.5, no second POST to /api/public/contribution-estimator is fired (the auto re-run never happens). Network listener saw only the initial baseline POST and no follow-up.

Participant doc has pension_status='part_pension' but on mount the form shows 'Full pension' selected. The onParticipantUpdated/initial-fetch path is not mapping pension_status into form state, so the part-pension-specific rate inputs (independence_rate_pct / everyday_rate_pct) never become visible and therefore can't be auto-hydrated with the saved 17.5.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from dev-mode source-injection wrapper — not product code, same as iter41/42.

ContributionEstimator initial useEffect that fetches /api/participants on mount should map pension_status + rates into form state, not just classification — matches the implementation in ReassessmentLetter.jsx which IS working.

rca of the issue: ProfileInlinePrompts.jsx PromptRow likely has two render branches (checkbox/multi-select vs input/number). The savedMeta + relativeTime trail line was added to the checkbox branch (verified via Budget Calc) but appears missing from the input branch — that's why the part_pension_actual_independence_pct row never shows the trail testid. Additionally, ContributionEstimator's onParticipantUpdated handler maps classification but not pension_status into form state, and the post-save re-run condition (presumably 'if result exists') may not be firing because the baseline result hadn't fully propagated yet. Mitigation: unify the trail-line render in PromptRow regardless of editor style, and add pension_status to the field map in onParticipantUpdated.
